messages.text: BL-1655 🎵 in progress — At relaunch the orphan-claim sweep re-delivers a dead seat's claim into the queue its sibling seat also reads, with nothing naming the seat that held it, so on 2026-09-20 coder@2 claimed BL-1652's Work note 26 s after the sweep took it from the coder seat and the ticket was built twice: a reclaimed file carries the seat that held it, that seat claims it at once, a sibling defers it for the cross-seat deadline and then claims out loud, and a one-seat stage is unchanged
